preregistration: D-361 (the pre-registration of the Phase 2 exit gate's mechanism test; details by the closest D-entries, D-181: D-152 4b, D-163, D-174, D-177, D-302, D-303, D-318 (7), D-320); D-156, D-164 (the estimator, both levels); D-117 (the selections of record); D-248 (5% beside); D-320 (4), D-362 (split v2 and its join rule); D-325 (the durable layer sets); D-307 (1) (durable caches only)
choices: (a) Probe set: the selected C only (D-361 (2) names it; D-361 (4)'s beside list has no C=1 row), so no C=1 cell and no reversed-order refit is computed on Phase 2 (they are twomoment_cells' sensitivity rows, D-163 (3)).

(b) Probe fit: per seed paired.fit_probe on the D-117 80% split in permutation order at the selected C, the fit twomoment_cells uses (D-152 P1); at L* it must equal the selection's own fit (selection_tpr_v2.seed_probes) bit for bit in mu, sd, w and b, and reproduce the selection record's ho20 TPRs exactly (D-117; float16_check_d364 step 4).

(c) Partition seeds on p2wg: item level 20261006, the seed of the first Phase 2 D-156 record on this axis (float16_check_d364.DRAW_SEED, same pooled negatives, same order), so draw r is the same item split everywhere on the axis (D-156); cluster level 20261007, a distinct fixed per-axis seed (D-164).

(d) Pool order: v2 calibration in its file's order, then the v2 evaluation negatives in theirs (D-156's 'calibration negatives then eval negatives' read through D-320 (4)'s join rule; as float16_check_d364).

(e) Cluster level: units are the cluster labels of manifests/phase2_pool_clusters.json (the D-164 rule: exact Jaccard >= 0.5, connected components) restricted to the 11,000 pooled negatives, each label with two or more pooled members one unit, every other negative its own unit; the manifest is bound through the v2 record's v1 record and that record's input sha256 (D-164, D-320).

(f) Layers: the cells are every layer both sides hold (D-361 (2): 'GRID6 plus the pre side's L*, D-325; every layer both sides hold', read operationally, so nothing is dropped, D-361 (5)): the layers that every cache of both sides holds, by the records. The job refuses unless GRID6(NL) (subset_p2.grid6) plus the pre side's L* for the pooling (D-325 (2)) are among them; held layers beyond that set (a subset that also carries another pair's L*) are cells too, listed per record as config.layers_beyond_grid6_plus_pre_lstar.

(g) The post side's v1 calibration cache comes from its durable select set: the p2tpl select record where that is ingested (its ingest index exists), else its p2sub select record (D-325 (1), (4); D-307 (1)); exactly one must be.

(h) 5% is computed in the same job on the same probes, items and draws (D-248: 'the same draws, seeds, probes and inputs as at 1%'), stored beside as cells_fpr5 and npz keys ending '__fpr5'; the anchor job proves the 5% path against the Phase 1 _fpr5 record (D-248's self-anchor purpose), so no separate 5% pipeline exists.

(i) P2-M.2's accuracy line (D-177, D-322 (4)): per cell e = |log realised - log predicted| from the per-cell D-156 estimates (twomoment_fit.d156_estimates, as twomoment_supplement); a cell whose e is not finite (a zero or undefined prediction) is a miss: outside x1.5 and +inf in the median; the share is over every cell; Phase 1's convention (defined cells only) is reported beside, as D-322 (4) asks for both.

(j) P2-M.1 is HELD iff the pair-cluster 95% interval exists and its ends bracket 1 (inclusive); an interval that cannot be formed is FAILED with its reason. The interval is twomoment_fit's pair bootstrap (its wols, the replicate multiplicities drawn as it draws them, paired.ci), anchored on twomoment_fit_r2.json's headline (D-305's re-issue of twomoment_fit.json; D-163, D-174).
(k) P2-M.3 compares the two shares of (i) over the same headline cells; 'strictly larger', so a tie is FAILED.

(l) The summary first anchors its scoring on Phase 1: on the nine Phase 1 records it must reproduce twomoment_fit_r2.json's headline (point, intervals, counts), twomoment_supplement_r4.json's all-cells accuracy lines for moment_full_in_sample and translation_in_sample, and its per-pair offset rows (mean offset, cell counts, D-156 partition band) at both levels exactly (D-361 (6); D-248's self-anchor); the re-issues of D-305 replace the superseded twomoment_fit.json and twomoment_supplement_r3.json (the same values, repo IDs named), bound through logs/reissue_d305_20261001.sha256 (pinned). twomoment_supplement is not imported: its accuracy and offset lines are repeated here (accuracy_line, within_draw_mean, offset_row) and this anchor is their check.

(m) Beside lines (D-361 (4)) carry quantities only, no HELD/FAILED: the other five predictors; last-token; the deployer's layer; 5%; the D-164 cluster level; per pair (D-177 (2a): the mean offset log(realised/predicted) with its D-156 partition band, and the accuracy line; no pair-cluster interval for one pair); the tokenizer-change pair (one pair: accuracy line, mean offset with partition band, the OLS point over its cells without an interval, D-177); the LoRA line (CHOICES (v)-(x)); Pearson r with its pair-cluster interval in every fit line (D-174).

(n) D-354 (3): the selections of record are used (D-361 (2)); the summary lists, beside, for every selection record the pairs use, whether D-354's cluster-grouped ho20 changes its cell, with both cells and the margins.

(o) Float16 cross-check: on D-364's cell (Mistral-7B-Instruct v0.1 -> v0.2, user-span mean, L*) the probes' fingerprints, the six score matrices' sha256 and the realised 1% and 5% D-156 reports must equal float16_check_d364.json's arm A, or the job refuses: a check of the v2 join path that the Phase 1 anchor cannot reach (as twomoment_cells checks damage_d156_r2, D-173).

(p) Anchor pair: repair_WG_mistral_base2instruct, the simplest Phase 1 inputs for this path: no input is pin-only (its D-170 block is unchanged since the record, so the comparison is value for value), it is on WildGuardMix, the dataset Phase 2's p2wg axis is drawn from, with 11 near-duplicate clusters so the cluster path is exercised, it has the plain 17-layer, 4096-wide grid and an ungated model (Mistral-7B v0.1 -> Instruct v0.1, whose post side is Phase 2's first pre side), and both its 1% record and its _fpr5 twin are named by the pinned fits.

(q) The anchor compares every value the Phase 2 path computes (the selected-C cells at every layer, both levels, 1% and 5%, and their per-draw rows); twomoment_cells' C=1 cells and reversed-order refit are outside that path (a) and are not recomputed; the npz keys the path does not form must be exactly the reversed-order columns, NaN on every selected row.
(r) The tokenizer-change pair runs both poolings, like every headline pair (D-361 (4)'s last-token line).

(s) The pair-cluster bootstrap resamples the nine pairs as clusters (D-163); pairs sharing a model (OLMo-2 SFT and DPO, Tulu-3 DPO are each one pair's post side and the next pair's pre side) are not modelled as dependent, as twomoment_fit's note says of Phase 1.

(t) Each Phase 2 cell's D-170 block says no input is pin-only (every cache read at its record's sha256 from its ingest index, D-307 (1)); Phase 1's registry block is kept in the anchor, where it must equal the record's.

(u) Final names need GUARDRAIL_CACHE_DIRS unset (hh_sensitivity_d363's rule: the anchor's Phase 1 caches come from the input registry's directory) and the reused files at their reviewed bytes (REUSED_SHA256).

(v) The LoRA line's arms are the 27 trained adapters of D-343 (alpaca, hh-harmless, pku-saferlhf x steps 25, 100, 400 x seeds 0, 1, 2) on Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 (the base: the pre side, its D-117 selection of record); the step-0 checkpoints are D-343 (2)'s gate against the base, not arms, and are not read. Each adapter is one update (base -> adapter) through the same path as a pair (D-361 (2): 'their own line').

(w) The LoRA line's cells are the layers the storage decision keeps (D-361 (2); option C, D-365: L* alone, both poolings, float32) that the base also holds; one job per pooling loads the base's caches, fits its probes and gathers its v2 matrices once, then reads each adapter's durable p2sub caches (D-307 (1)); every adapter's caches name the base's selection record and L* in their layer plans (role 'post').
(x) In the LoRA line's fit each adapter is its own cluster in the bootstrap (D-163: an update is the cluster), B = 5000 with the same seed; the line is beside, never a verdict (D-361 (4)).

(y) BOS check (D-361 (5), D-318 (6)): step 1 reads results/phase2/bos_check_p2.json and refuses unless both sides' models are 'ok' there: listed at the side's revision, cache_tie status 'ok', prompts_tie and plain_path ok, not in ties_failed, cache_tie_skipped or cache_tie_incomplete, and no tokenizer left unloaded; its sha256 is recorded. The LoRA line requires the base's line; the adapters are not in the scan and use the base's tokenizer (D-343).

(z) Summary inputs and D-170: the summary binds the anchor record and the 22 records with their npz to their lines of logs/twomoment_p2_d361.sha256 (the list's manifest job; it must list exactly those 45 files) and records the manifest's sha256; every cell's input_verification flag must be None (twomoment_fit's rule: no cell may be vouched for by a pin alone), carried as 'D-170: 0 of n cells flagged' on the headline, each verdict and each beside line.

pooled_negatives.order: v2 calibration (its file's order), then v2 evaluation negatives (its file's order)

config.estimator: D-156 as D-361 (2): paired.repartition_estimate and twomoment_cells.one_partition on the pooled v2 negatives re-partitioned at the v2 sizes, the frozen v2 split as one more draw
config.join_rule: A v2 split's caches are its items gathered by item_id from the model's v1 caches, each item from the cache of the split v1 put it in (v1 calibration: the select record's p2wg/calibration cache; v1 eval or pool4d: the rest record's p2wg/eval or p2wg/pool4d cache), whichever v2 split it is now in; plan.items_from_v1_to_v2 counts the moved negatives by v1 and v2 split (positives stay in their v1 split). A cache keyed 'p2wg/<split>' is a v1 cache and is never read as a v2 split. Under D-307 (1) a result reads only ingested caches, so a v2 reader needs the rest caches (or their durable layer subsets) ingested and indexed first.
